author: GoPro
description:
GoPro Athlete @FelipeAgurto returned to Valparaíso for the 22nd Red Bull Cerro Abajo where he took home bronze in one of the most technical urban downhill MTB courses in the world. The legendary track features a brutal 230-meter vertical drop and nearly 280 stairs, pushing riders to their limits through steep hills, tight corners, and maze-like city streets. Watch Agurto's POV as he charges down the course, finishing just seconds shy of the top spot.

For more bike content 👉  @GoProBike
